```artifact
Feature: Alarms - U04

  Scenario: Compute HIGH VTE alarm - Normal Value
    Given the VTE for the current breath is 5.5
    And the VTE threshold is 5.0
    When the breath is processed
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should be active

  Scenario: Compute HIGH VTE alarm - Threshold Value
    Given the VTE for the current breath is 5.0
    And the VTE threshold is 5.0
    When the breath is processed
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should be active

  Scenario: Compute HIGH VTE alarm - Below Threshold
    Given the VTE for the current breath is 4.5
    And the VTE threshold is 5.0
    When the breath is processed
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should not be active

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath - Normal Value
    Given a breath is received with flow rate 10 L/min and duration 2 seconds
    When the breath is processed
    Then the VTE should be computed as 20.0

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath - Zero Flow
    Given a breath is received with flow rate 0 L/min and duration 2 seconds
    When the breath is processed
    Then the VTE should be computed as 0.0

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath - Zero Duration
    Given a breath is received with flow rate 10 L/min and duration 0 seconds
    When the breath is processed
    Then the VTE should be computed as 0.0

  Scenario Outline: LOW VTE Alarm Priority
    Given a "LOW VTE" alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm priority should be "medium"
    Examples:
      | Alarm Type |
      | LOW VTE    |

  Scenario Outline: HIGH VTE Alarm Priority
    Given a "HIGH VTE" alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm priority should be "medium"
    Examples:
      | Alarm Type |
      | HIGH VTE   |

  Scenario: Pressure High Alarm Cancellation - Immediate Re-trigger
    Given a "pressure high" alarm is triggered
    When the alarm is cancelled
    And 1 minute passes
    When the "pressure high" condition reoccurs
    Then the "pressure high" alarm should be re-triggered

  Scenario: Pressure High Alarm Cancellation - Delayed Re-trigger
    Given a "pressure high" alarm is triggered
    When the alarm is cancelled
    And 2 minutes pass
    When the "pressure high" condition reoccurs
    Then the "pressure high" alarm should not be re-triggered

  Scenario: O2 Disconnection Alarm - Triggered
    Given the O2 input line is disconnected
    When the system checks for O2 connection
    Then a high-priority alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: O2 Disconnection Alarm - Connected
    Given the O2 input line is connected
    When the system checks for O2 connection
    Then a high-priority alarm should not be triggered

  Scenario: Display Multiple Active Alarms
    Given a "HIGH VTE" alarm is active
    And a "pressure high" alarm is active
    And an "O2 Disconnection" alarm is active
    When the alarm display is requested
    Then all three alarms ("HIGH VTE", "pressure high", "O2 Disconnection") should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Event Log - Alarm Confirmation
    Given an alarm "<alarm_type>" is triggered
    When the alarm is confirmed
    Then the event log should include a record of the confirmed "<alarm_type>" alarm setting
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | HIGH VTE   |
      | LOW VTE    |
      | pressure high |
      | O2 Disconnection |
```
